MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p, COALESCE(p.death_date, '2026/10/14') AS reference_date
WITH p,
     CAST(split_part(reference_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) AS ref_year,
     CAST(split_part(reference_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) AS ref_month,
     CAST(split_part(reference_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) AS ref_day,
     CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) AS birth_year,
     CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) AS birth_month,
     CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) AS birth_day
WITH p,
     ref_year - birth_year - CASE WHEN ref_month < birth_month OR (ref_month = birth_month AND ref_day < birth_day) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
WHERE age < 78
RETURN p.position AS col1, p.nationality AS col2, age AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CASE
    WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN strptime(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d')
    ELSE strptime(p.birth_date, '%B %d, %Y')
  END AS birth_date,
  CASE
    WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN strptime('2026/10/14', '%Y/%m/%d')
    WHEN p.death_date CONTAINS '/' THEN strptime(p.death_date, '%Y/%m/%d')
    ELSE strptime(p.death_date, '%B %d, %Y')
  END AS reference_date
WITH p, birth_date, reference_date,
  date_part('year', reference_date) - date_part('year', birth_date) -
  CASE
    WHEN date_part('month', reference_date) < date_part('month', birth_date)
      OR (date_part('month', reference_date) = date_part('month', birth_date)
          AND date_part('day', reference_date) < date_part('day', birth_date))
    THEN 1 ELSE 0
  END AS age
WHERE age < 78
RETURN p.position AS col1, p.nationality AS col2, age AS col3, p.name AS name_player
